text: Now, for a few minutes, quietly tell the name of your ishta daivam or the mantra you always japa.
Before you begin, decide on a count — eleven, twenty-one, fifty-four, or a hundred and eight.
With every japa, touch the counter below once.
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama ॥
Whichever deity you worship, the mantra you are used to is the right one.
